description: Core permissions for the main window. The sidecar is spawned from Rust, not from JavaScript, so the webview needs no shell permission at all. The keyring permissions let the settings UI store and clear API keys in the OS keychain, and only that: reading them back is done in Rust at spawn time, never by the webview, so `keyring:default` (which includes get) is deliberately not granted. The opener plugin is granted nothing here either: folder and Obsidian opening go through the app's own commands, which refuse any path outside the data directory before the plugin sees it. `core:window:allow-start-dragging` lets the toolbar move the window on macOS, where the title bar is an overlay and the toolbar's empty space stands in for it (Phase 20, decision D5); it moves the window and does nothing else.
